name: AP Memory Technology Corporation
summary: AP Memory Technology Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, licenses, manufactures, and sells customized memory-related integrated circuit (IC) chip products and technologies in China, Singapore, Taiwan, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company provides pseudo static random-access memory (PSRAM) and low power double data rate (LPDDR) for IoT, wearables, and display devices; and stack silicon capacitors for temperature and voltage stability.
